summary: ansible-core 2.12 deprecated Python 2.6 targets, made when conditionals treat any non-empty string (including 'false') as true with CONDITIONAL_BARE_VARS having no effect, and deprecated ActionBase._remote_checksum() in favour of _execute_remote_stat().
questions: My when: teardown runs even though teardown is 'false', why?
Can I still manage hosts with Python 2.6?

answer_card.title: String booleans in when need | bool
answer_card.answer_md:
- `when:` no longer parses string booleans: **any non-empty string is true**, including `'false'`. `CONDITIONAL_BARE_VARS` has no effect. Use `| bool`:

```yaml
vars:
  teardown: 'false'
tasks:
  - include_tasks: teardown.yml
    when: teardown | bool
```

- Python **2.6** targets deprecated (removed in 2.13).
- `ActionBase._remote_checksum()` → **`_execute_remote_stat()`**.
